svg.aria-label: A recovery waits 7, 14 or 30 days. Every day you and your alert contacts are alerted, and any of them can cancel it. At the end your bitcoin moves to a new 2-of-3 with a replacement key.
svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
